changelog.title: Changelog
changelog.lead: Changes in each release of iGM CraftCeon Launcher.

items: Fixed a false bridge response timeout when starting a game download: the progress page now opens immediately, instead of showing an error after the download had already started.

Fixed the standalone download progress window not updating: progress is pushed in real time every 100 ms across every download stage, including the fallback download path used when the site manifest is unavailable.
Multi-threaded sharded downloads: large files are fetched in parallel over HTTP Range and verified with streaming hashing, for smoother progress.
Global task queue: up to 8 files concurrently, with automatic concurrency reduction and backoff when rate limited.
Version library status now follows local files: deleting a local version immediately shows it as not downloaded, and reinstalling stays available.
Directory layout update: the game installs to iGML/.minecraft under the chosen folder, with mods and shaders isolated per instance.
First official release, establishing four core capabilities: instances, Java, resources, and accounts.
Added instance management: isolated mods, settings, and worlds.
Added Java management: automatic detection and per-version runtime recommendations.
Added resource downloads: search and install mods, resource packs, and modpacks.
Added official account verification and offline mode for both online and local scenarios.

install.title: Installation guide
install.lead: This chapter covers the system requirements, installation steps, and verification for iGM CraftCeon Launcher.

system.title: System requirements
items: OS: Windows 10 / 11 64-bit.
CPU: dual-core or better with SSE2 support.
Memory: 4 GB or more recommended, increased for larger modpacks.
Storage: at least 2 GB free for the launcher and its data.
Runtime: a working Java runtime installed, or installed automatically by the launcher.

steps.title: Installation steps
items: Get the iGM CraftCeon Launcher package from the download page (zip archive).
Extract the archive into one folder to get the installer bootstrapper and its payload.
Run iGM Installer-Setup.exe, choose an install directory, and finish the wizard.
On first launch, choose the language and data directory.
Confirm or install the matching runtime in Java management.
Create or import an instance, then launch the game.

verify.title: Verification and launch
verify.lead: After downloading, verify the installer integrity in PowerShell:
verify.after: Compare the result with the SHA256 shown on the download page; a match means the file is intact.

notes.title: Notes
items: Always get the installer from the official download page; avoid files from unknown sources.
If antivirus software blocks the installation, confirm the source and then allow it.
The launcher writes to its data directory; make sure it is readable and writable.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.lead: Frequently asked questions and answers about using iGM CraftCeon Launcher.
faq.q1: Do I need an official account to use it?
faq.a1: No. The launcher supports both official account verification and offline mode: an official account syncs skins and game data, while offline mode launches installed instances without a network.
faq.q2: Does the launcher install Java automatically?
faq.a2: Yes. Java management detects the local runtime and recommends a suitable version for the selected game version; if missing, the launcher can download and install it, or you can point to an existing path.
faq.q3: Downloads are slow. What can I do?
faq.a3: Downloads depend on the selected mirror. Switch mirrors in settings, or retry off-peak; interrupted downloads resume automatically.
faq.a4: Offline mode launches installed instances and resources without a network, with local verification keeping files intact. Switch back online to download new resources or sync account data.
faq.q5: How do I report issues or suggestions?
faq.a5: Email the team at igcraftlit@outlook.com, or submit feedback via https://igcraftlit.com. Adding “iGM CraftCeon Launcher” to the subject helps us locate the issue faster.
